helpMove: m <from> <to|f>      move fan <from> top to fan <to> / foundation (f)
helpRedeal: rd / redeal          gather, shuffle and redeal (up to 3 times)
helpAutoComplete: ac                   auto-play every available foundation move
helpUndo: u / undo             undo the last move
stuckDeadlock: No legal move remains and no redeals are left - type giveup to concede.
helpExampleAuto: ac                   send everything that can go to a foundation
